description: Look up recorded coupon eligibility and plan-level prices in the HomeDadPro public catalog when the user asks about a specific offer or purchase configuration. Returns the applicable code, verification date, billing conditions, article URLs and affiliate referral URLs. HDP is not universally applicable; some records have no discount or are reference-only. Does not apply coupons to a cart or initiate checkout.

accountCurrency.description: Simulated account currency; different from purchase fee currency. Omit to include both, with currency labels.

budget.description: Single account purchase fee in currency (USD by default). Split or milestone payment uses the total required if all stages pass, not only the upfront payment. Excludes conflicted or stale quotes.

currency.description: Purchase fee currency. Budget defaults to USD. No currency conversion; prices in different currencies are not ranked together.

firms.description: Firm IDs or names. Main futures IDs: lucid, tradeify, fundednext, apex, blueguardian, tradeday, tpt, ftmo-futures. FFF requires explicit fff. Perps includes vest.

market.description: Select the product market explicitly. Defaults to futures when omitted. SpiceProp and other forex/CFD programs require cfd. Company names do not automatically change this field.

plan.description: Exact planId previously returned by this server, for example cfd:spice:three. Not a display name such as 3-Step. Omit this field when the exact planId is unknown; filter by firm, market and size first.
